25
Israelfoɔ adwamammɔ ne abosonsom
1Na Israel tenaa Sitim. Na ɔman no firii aseɛ ne Moab mmabaa bɔɔ adwaman; 2#Num 31.16 na wɔhyiahyiaa ɔman no kɔɔ wɔn anyame afɔreduane ho; na ɔman no didii na wɔsɔree wɔn anyame no; 3#Deut 4.3 na Israel de ne ho bɔɔ Baal-peor ho. Na AWURADE bo fuu Israel; 4#2 Sa 21.6, 9; Deut 21.22-23 na AWURADE ka kyerɛɛ Mose sɛ: Fa ɔman no mu atitire no nyinaa, na sensɛne wɔn ma AWURADE, owia so, na AWURADE abufuhyeɛ no nsane mfiri Israel so. 5Na Mose ka kyerɛɛ Israel atemmufoɔ no sɛ: Monkunkum mo mmarima a wɔde wɔn ho kɔbɔɔ Baal-peor ho no.
6Na hwɛ, ɔbarima bi firi Israelfoɔ no mu bae a ɔde Midianni baa bi baa ne nuanom nkyɛn wɔ Mose ani so ne Israelfoɔ asafo no nyinaa ani so; ɛberɛ a wɔn deɛ, na wɔresu ahyiaeɛ ntomadan no ano. 7Na Ɔsɔfoɔ Aaron ba Eleasa ba Pinehas hunuiɛ no, ɔsɔre firii asafo no mu kɔfaa pea kurae, 8na ɔdii Israelni no akyi kɔɔ pia no mu, na ɔwowɔɔ wɔn baanu no, Israelni ne ɔbaa no nyinaa hwiree n’ayaase; na ɔhaw no to twa firii Israelfoɔ no so. 9#1 Ko 10.8 Na nnipa a wɔwuwuu ɔhaw no mu ano si mpem aduonu nnan.
10Na AWURADE kasa kyerɛɛ Mose sɛ: 11Ɔsɔfoɔ Aaron ba Eleasa ba Pinehas asianka m’abufuo afiri Israelfoɔ so, sɛ watwe me ho ninkunu wɔ wɔn mu a enti manhye Israelfoɔ wɔ me ninkuntwe mu. 12#1 Be 9.20 Enti ka sɛ: Hwɛ, mede m’asomdwoeɛ apam merema no, 13#Dwom 106.30-31 na ayɛ ɔno ne n’asefoɔ a wɔbɛba n’akyire no daa asɔfodie apam, ɛfiri sɛ watwe ninkunu ama ne Nyankopɔn, na wapata ama Israelfoɔ. 14Na Israelni a wɔkum no ne Midianni baa no din ne Simri, Salu ba a ɔyɛ Simeonfoɔ mpanimfie mu bapɔmma. 15#Num 31.8 Na Midianni baa a wɔkum no no din de Kosbi, Sur a ɔyɛ Midianfoɔ mu agya fie so panin no ba.
16Na AWURADE kasa kyerɛɛ Mose sɛ: 17#Num 31.2-10 Monteetee Midianfoɔ no na monku wɔn, 18ɛfiri sɛ wɔn nso a wɔde wɔn aniteɛ teetee mo, na wɔde daadaa mo de kɔsom Baal-peor, ne wɔn nuabaa Kosbi, Midian safohene no babaa a wɔkum no da a Peor ho haw no baeɛ no asɛm no nti.

app.t1_copy: I've bookmarked passages that are important to me. I've even read the whole thing through in a year thanks to the reading plans.
app.t2_copy: I love how you are able to connect with friends and the Bible reading plans are awesome. This application helps me also to stay consistent in reading because it has reminders for the plans. It also gives me another way to come closer to God. Download this and read every day!
app.t3_copy: Great app with a wide selection of Bibles to choose from. ... The audio Bibles are also wonderful and easy to understand.
app.t4_copy: Many translations and languages available, and many that can be downloaded to read offline. Many useful features, such as the ability to make notes and bookmarks.
app.t5_copy: I love how it has a lot of versions and that there are verses of the day, devotions, plans and community. Thanks for this free app. :)
app.t6_copy: Great because there are many different versions and I could download multiple versions for offline reading. I'm able to listen to this app.
app.t7_copy: Helps me to read the bible more. Love the search and share features and the variety of ways to share. Also like the audio versions.
app.t8_copy: This is a great tool for studying from multiple translations. It's also convenient for listening to the bible when you're driving.
app.t9_copy: This is the best bible app out there. It has the word in different languages and versions for online and offline use. It has devotionals for everything you could think of. You can connect with others and ultimately learn about God and his Word.
